title: Un-skip hebrew_rtl_p1_test.dart E2E-1510 — R-OB7 onboarding hardcoded-English bug is already fixed

evidence.quote: 'BUG R-OB7: onboarding profile-mode card text is hardcoded English '

why: The file's docstring (lines 30-33) and the E2E-1510 group's skip reason claim OnboardingProfileCreationStep hardcodes English mode-card copy ('Child Mode'/'Adult Mode'/'Fun & Rewards'/'Deep & Scholarly'/'ACTIVE'/'What should we call you?'). Every one of those UI strings in the current source routes through AppLocalizations (childModeCardTitle, adultModeCardTitle, childModeCardSubtitleFunRewards, onboardingNamePrompt, pointSettingsActiveBadge, ...), and app_he.arb carries real Hebrew translations, not English placeholders — the bug is fixed. The docstring's cited copy ('Deep & Scholarly') doesn't even match the current EN string ('Focused'), showing the annotation predates a later copy change too. Because the test stays skipped, nobody is regression-testing RTL/i18n correctness for the onboarding profile step, and anyone reading the skip reason is told a bug exists that doesn't — the exact opposite of the file's own 'confirm-bug→skip contract' (contrast with E2E-1511 in the same file, which correctly marks R-IC3 FIXED once the underlying bug was resolved).
recommendation: Remove the skip parameter from the E2E-1510 group, run the test to confirm it passes under he locale, and update/delete the stale R-OB7 docstring block (mirroring how R-IC3 is marked FIXED elsewhere in the same file); also close R-OB7 in docs/planning/e2e-test-suite-plan.md's risk register.
acceptance_criteria: test/e2e/journeys/hebrew_rtl_p1_test.dart E2E-1510 group runs unskipped and passes.
R-OB7 row in docs/planning/e2e-test-suite-plan.md marked fixed or removed.
